← Gàidhlig

Native check: Gàidhlig

Native speaker? Each line below is from the book. Read it and its question, then choose Correct if it is fine as it is, Needs change if it is not (and write how you would say it), or Not sure. Answer as many lines as you like.

Round 1 of 2. After you send, the next round has more lines.

Rounds: 1 · 2

You don't need to have read the book. The grey lines above each line show what comes just before it; only the line marked at the side is being checked.

  • Maman (mother), Baba (father) and -jan after a name (dear) are kept from Persian on purpose, like other Persian words such as beit and ghazal.
  • Names stay Persian (Niloofar, Hooman). Maman and Baba are written with a capital, like names, because that is what the children call their parents.
  • Some characters swear, speak crudely or mispronounce words on purpose; the question says so when it matters.
Line 1

– Càite air m' amhach a tha e sgrìobhte gur e àite-coise a th' ann?

– Gu h-oibeactach, chaidh mi a bhrusadh mo fhiaclan, nigh mi mo làmhan 's m' aodann cuideachd, chan eil na speuclairean agam orm, chan fhaca mi.

Thog Farid a chluasag 's a phlaide agus thàinig e a laighe air an leabaidh os cionn mo thè-sa, an leabaidh air an do chaidil Bahman fad a' chiad dà theirm den oilthigh, agus an oidhche sin, faisg air trì bliadhna, bha blàths corp Bahman air a dhol à cuimhne an tashkaid air an leabaidh.

Is 'tashkaid' a clear word for the mattress on the bed?

Line 2

– Sùil Iolaire, thig an seo. Dh'fhàg thu do speuclairean aig bonn mo leapa.

– ... leis na sùilean laga aige, chaidh e a dh'Ameireagaidh às dèidh a cheum mhaighstireil. Gu dearbh, mar a chanadh e fhèin, gu h-oibeactach, ha-ha, gu h-oibeactach nam biodh aon againn ri dhol thall thairis, b' e Sùil Iolaire a bhiodh ann.

Mura biodh an sgriubha aige air stad air mar gum feumadh e ceum fhaighinn bho Oilthigh Sharif an toiseach mus fàgadh e Ìran, bhiodh e air Ìran fhàgail dìreach às dèidh a' cheum-bhun-sgoile.

Is 'cheum-bhun-sgoile' clear for a first university degree, a bachelor's?

Line 3

…air càch le fearg. Bhon oidhche sin, cha robh dad air fhàgail againn ri èisteachd ris. A-rithist, mar na làithean ron Walkman, às dèidh do sholais taigh Negar a dhol às, rachamaid agus shuidheamaid an sin, air a' chabhsair ri taobh na prìomh shràide, a' coimhead nan càraichean a' dol seachad.

Às dèidh an latha sin, cha rachadh Niloofar còmhla ris na nigheanan eile a-null gu bothan Yaghoob. Rachadh i dìreach a-mach às an oilthigh.

Agus nam bhruadar, gach latha, nuair a choinnicheadh Niloofar agus Sina, bheireadh iad làmh a chèile.

Is it clear Niloofar and Sina shake hands when they meet?

Line 4

– Tha thusa nad Rashid cuideachd.

Thionndaidh Eskandar ionnsaigh, a cheann is a bhroilleach a' teannadh ga m' ionnsaigh. Bha a shùilean cruinn aige, agus le fonn garbh, gun a bhlas Alain-Delon fhèin a chall, thuirt e:

– Seall dè an cnap-mòine a rinn thu, a bhalaich cac-eanchainn.

Someone is scolded for a blunder. Is 'cnap-mòine' clear as a big mess?

Line 5

Chunnaic mi rud beag soilleir an oisean eile den mhullach. Choimhead mi gu cùramach. B' e Farid a bh' ann. Bliadhna às dèidh do ghlùin Farid tighinn a-nuas air sròn Eskandar, bha Farid na shuidhe crois-chasach an oisean dorcha den mhullach. Bha e air fhalt a rùsgadh.

Bha ad le oir aig Hamid gus fhalt a bha air a bhearradh gu goirid a chòmhdach.

A bharrachd air caraid co-ogha maighstir-ciùird an fhir-chèile aca, cha robh ach am falt-cùil aige na adhbhar pròis.

Is 'an fhir-chèile aca' right for their brother-in-law, a sister's husband?

Line 6

– A bheil sibh airson sabaid?

Bha an làraidh nam làimh ach cha b' urrainn dhuinn ruith – bha Negar na seasamh a' coimhead oirnn. Thuirt Taghi:

– Ma tha thu a' smaoineachadh an làraidh sin a thoirt leat – smaoinich a-rithist.

Taghi is saying yes to the fight, on one condition. Is that clear?

Line 7

Chaidh sinn a-mach air an doras. Thuirt e:

– B' e lighiche air tinneasan inntinn a bh' anns an lighiche a cheannaich an taigh.

A rèir choltais, bha eagal air a bhean ro na h-euslaintich aige, is sin as coireach, an aghaidh a h-uile taigh eile, gu bheil na sgàilean fiodha dubha seo againn air beulaibh an taighe.

Is 'sgàilean fiodha' right for a wooden fence in front of the house?

Line 8

– Ceart, rach is gabh cadal, a Nini-jan.

…dà itealan a chaidh seachad roimhe. Cia mheud naidheachd mì-thlachdmhor eile a tha air a bhith air an cumail bhuam? Cia mheud snàth caol eile a chaidh a tharraing a-mach à mo chridhe mìosan air ais gun fhios agam? Bidh mi a' gabhail fasgadh anns an aithris uair is uair de na tha mi air sgrìobhadh.

A-nis, on a tha mo thràchdas seachad agus mi air socrachadh beagan, faodaidh mi sgrìobhadh gu Niloofar gus fios a bhith aice gun do thog mi broinn-tasgaidh dhi, làn fhaclan.

Is 'broinn-tasgaidh' a clear word for a piggy bank, here full of words?

Line 9

– Tha, tha Hamoon na ainm math dhut. Coltach ri Hamoon san fhilm, tha thusa cuideachd làn cheistean. Làn iomagain, agus tha thu nad thùs do-fhoighidinn, chan ann dhut fhèin ach dhòmhsa.

Thuirt Hooman:

– Agus thusa, leis an dòigh bhoidich agad air bruidhinn, bu chòir gum biodh Alain Bodlon mar ainm ort.

'Alain Bodlon' is meant as a rude pun on the actor Alain Delon. Would Scottish Gaelic readers get it? If not, what word could?
